system_prompt: You are Kestrel Assist, an automated assistant of Kestrel Mutual. Speak English. Refer to members. Never say debt or debt collection. Before actual bank verification do not disclose products, amounts, days late, arrears, overdue, owe, payment or balance. Never accept card details. Never invent a discount, waiver, freeze or plan. Literal controller speech and confirmed bank receipts govern all statements.

extraction_schema.name: events
extraction_schema.description: Event v1: latest speech only. One short tagged row per distinct act, ending ; and final !. Format k=K|p=TARGET|a=AMOUNT|d=DATE|t=TIME|c=0or1|u=COMPONENT|g=SCOPE|r=ROW|s=SOURCE;! Only k,c,s required; omit irrelevant tags. Never emit empty tags or unknown/duplicate tags. s is the short exact source clause, not whole speech. Escape % | ; = ! as %25 %7C %3B %3D %21. k is accept,aside,callback,confirm,dispute,hardship,human,paid,pause,proposal,question,refuse,repeat,restructure,resume,stop,support,unknown,withdraw. p=current,all,loans,exact returned ID,known displayed label,credit card,personal loan,car loan or API enum, or comma list; all requires genuine collective scope. a=plain positive EUR digits with optional dot and 1-2 decimals, or full,floor,offered. d=complete exact natural date (month name, ordinal, optional year, weekday, this/next weekday, today/tomorrow), ISO YYYY-MM-DD, offered, or vague for an indefinite period. Keep ordinary date punctuation; never infer missing fragment. t=HH:MM. c=1 only complete present self assertion, not quotation/hypothetical/negation; c=0 unfinished with u=amount,date,both,unknown. g=shared when one date explicitly covers multiple products; total for aggregate money; each for explicit each. Independent identical dates are not shared. r=zero-based earlier row explicitly replaced by correction, requiring correction words in s. Consent is confirm ONLY in confirm phase; acceptance of offer is accept and still needs later readback/consent. Do not turn AI questions into human requests. Retain all siblings. Context: phase {{phase_context}}; {{calendar_context}}; returned products {{product_context}}; exact offers {{offer_context}}. Literal examples: k=proposal|p=credit card|a=100.00|d=2026-10-19|c=1|s=I can pay 100 on the card on October 19;! k=paid|p=credit_card|c=1|s=I already paid the credit card;k=refuse|p=personal loan|c=1|s=I will not pay the personal loan;k=proposal|p=car_loan|a=full|d=next Friday|c=1|s=I can pay the full car loan next Friday;! k=confirm|p=all|c=1|s=Yes, I agree;! k=proposal|p=current|a=75.00|c=0|u=date|s=75 euros on next;! k=callback|d=2026-10-15|t=10:30|c=1|s=October 15 at 10:30;! k=accept|p=current|c=1|s=Yes, that works;! k=human|c=0|s=Could I speak to;! k=refuse|p=all|c=1|s=No to all of them;! k=withdraw|p=current|c=1|s=Do not record that yet;!

code.default:
import json
try:
    s=vars.get('bank_state','')
    s=json.loads(s) if isinstance(s,str) and s else s if isinstance(s,dict) else {}
    recorded=s.get('recorded',{})
    vars['close_outcome']='promise' if recorded else 'no_promise' if s.get('verified') else 'not_verified'
    vars['close_reason']='NP-SYS' if s.get('verified') else 'NV-FAIL'
    vars['dialogue_line']='I cannot safely continue. Please contact Kestrel Mutual'+(' or visit any Kestrel branch with photo ID' if not s.get('verified') else '')+'. Thank you. Goodbye.'
    vars['unresolved_effects']='Guard execution unavailable; no further financial writes authorized.'
except Exception:
    vars['close_outcome']='not_verified'
    vars['close_reason']='NV-FAIL'
    vars['dialogue_line']='Please visit any Kestrel branch with photo ID. Thank you. Goodbye.'
